final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_sex_ratio FROM sex_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT s.sex, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_ratio - o.avg_sex_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE s.avg_ratio > o.avg_sex_ratio), excess_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_excess) AS avg_excess FROM above_overall), above_excess AS (SELECT a.sex, a.avg_ratio, a.ratio_excess, a.avg_ratio - e.avg_excess AS excess_over_average FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN excess_average AS e WHERE a.avg_ratio > e.avg_excess) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(ratio_excess), AVG(excess_over_average) FROM above_excess
